title: Total Amount Due vs Current Electricity Use
audience: Homeowners preparing bill data for a solar quote
premise: Total amount due can include previous balances; size solar from monthly kWh history, ideally 12 months.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the episode plan (data/episodes.json) title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-25.

sources: Sources: Moneymax & FilipiKnow Meralco bill guides; UMD and
Illinois Extension solar sizing guides (checked 25 Nov 2026)

cues.text: Total amount due ba ang basehan ng solar mo?
Minsan, kasama sa total ang hindi pa nabayarang balance.
Kaya puwedeng mas malaki ito kaysa sa nagamit mo ngayong buwan.
Ang dapat tingnan, ang kWh na nagamit kada buwan.
cues.say: Ang dapat tingnan, ang kilowatt-hour na nagamit kada buwan.

cues.text: Mas maganda kung may kWh ka ng isang taon, para kita ang average.
cues.say: Mas maganda kung may kilowatt-hour ka ng isang taon, para kita ang average.

cues.text: Para tama ang laki ng solar na irerekomenda sa'yo.
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

sources.title: How to Compute Meralco Bill
excerpts: The bill lists generation, transmission, system loss, distribution and other charges.
The amount to pay can include remaining balance from a previous bill, so it can be higher than current charges alone.

sources.title: Estimate system size and cost
excerpts: Average your monthly kWh from past bills, then divide by local sun hours to estimate system size.

sources.title: Working on Solar: Design and System Sizing (FS-2023-0655)
excerpts: Preliminary size: energy use divided by peak sun hours; use 12-24 months of kWh history; treat as a first estimate before site-specific design.
